name: HR 3. Workforce Distribution & Location Analysis
rawText:
# Do you know how your workforce is distributed across locations?
# 
#  - Which offices have the largest workforces?
#  - How many departments are represented at each location?
#  - What is the mix of full-time, part-time, and contract employees?
#  - How long have employees been with the company on average?
#  - What is the total annual payroll for each office?
#  - Which locations have the highest staffing costs?
# 
# What if you could combine location data, employee information, employment types, hire dates, and salary details into a single readable query — including conditional aggregations, distinct counts, and date calculations?
# No complex SQL. No manually written joins. No separate queries for each calculation.
# **Just describe what you want to know. Let OQuery handle the complexity.**
# ____________________________________________________________

Locations:
    City OfficeCity
    State
    Employees.Count(Id) Headcount
    Employees.CountDistinct(DepartmentId) DepartmentsRepresented
    Employees.CountIf(EmploymentType = 'Full-time') FullTime
    Employees.CountIf(EmploymentType = 'Part-time') PartTime
    Employees.CountIf(EmploymentType = 'Contract') Contractors
    Employees.Avg(HireDate.DateSub(<2025-10-31>) / 365.25) AverageTenureYears
    Employees.Sum(Salary).Round(2) AnnualPayroll
Order Headcount DESC, AnnualPayroll DESC
